# GhostWire

> GhostWire is a decentralized, anonymous peer-to-peer mesh communication platform built in Rust. It enables secure, censorship-resistant messaging and file sharing without central servers, using libp2p for networking and strong end-to-end encryption.

GhostWire provides a web-based interface for mesh networking, supporting features like anonymous peer discovery, encrypted communication channels, and a built-in AI assistant. The project is open source under AGPLv3.

## Key Files

## Technical Stack

- **Language**: Rust (backend), TypeScript (frontend)
- **Networking**: libp2p (TCP/QUIC/WebRTC)
- **Cryptography**: Ed25519, X25519, AES-256-GCM
- **Build**: Cargo, Tauri (desktop), WebAssembly (browser)
